description_te: BPL కుటుంబాలకు ₹25 లక్షల వరకు ఉచిత వైద్య సేవలు. 949+ రకాల treatments cover. Network hospitals లో cashless treatment. Ayushman Bharat-PMJAY తో integrate అవుతోంది.
description_en: Free medical treatment up to ₹25 lakhs for BPL families. Covers 949+ treatments across 14+ specialties. Cashless treatment at network hospitals. Being integrated with Ayushman Bharat-PMJAY.

eligibility_criteria.residency: Must be permanent resident of Andhra Pradesh
eligibility_criteria.ration_card: White ration card (BPL) linked with Aadhaar
eligibility_criteria.health_card: Must possess Aarogyasri Health Card / Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva card
eligibility_criteria.coverage: 949+ treatments across 14+ specialties: cardiology, oncology, neurosurgery, nephrology, orthopedics, ophthalmology etc.

mandatory: Aarogyasri Health Card / Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva card

benefit_amount: Up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year (cashless). Covers admissions, consultations, surgeries, medications, meals.
application_process_te:
1. drntrvaidyaseva.ap.gov.in లో sign in చేయండి
2. Documents submit చేయండి
3. Network hospital కి వెళ్ళండి
4. Hospital Aarogyasri counter లో registration
5. Pre-authorization approval తర్వాత treatment start
6. Emergency cases లో treatment ముందు, authorization తర్వాత
go_reference: GO Ms. No. 174, dated 2019 (original); renamed under TDP government
